text:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up — we have three external visitors Tue/Wed for demos. Please remind teams to escort them from reception.
Ethan: Which days specifically? I have a 10am meeting Tue, might need an extra badge.
Maya (People Ops): Tue 10:00–11:30 (Acme demo), Wed 14:00–15:00 (partner sync), and Wed 16:00–17:00 (customer tour).
Priya: Can external badges be pre-printed? I can meet at reception 15m early to pick them up.
Maya (People Ops): Yep — email guest names to people-ops@redwood.ai by EOD today. Reception Bot: Guest badges will be printed if names are added to the front-desk queue. Use this form: https://forms.company/guest
Ethan: Also, any seating swaps for the demo room? I'd like to reserve the corner table for the projector.
Sam: Corner table reserved for Tue 09:45–12:00. @Ethan send me a reminder if you want cables.
Priya: Small FYI — a couple of packages arrived marked 'Jules' and 'Ethan'. Please check mailroom 2.
Jules: That's mine — thanks! Tracking shows a fragile sticker: `1Z999AA10123456784`.
Ethan: Mine is actually a monitor arm, pinging facilities for help with unboxing tomorrow.
Maya (People Ops): Reminder: visitors need to show ID for badges. If someone forgets, reception will call the host.
Sam: Cool. @Maya can we get an extra parking permit for the Acme VP on Tue? They're driving in.
Maya (People Ops): Sent request to facilities. Parking permit pending approval — will update the thread.
Reception Bot: New package scan: 2 items in mailroom 2. Labels: Jules, Ethan. If unclaimed after 7 days, we'll return to sender. :package:
Ethan: Thanks — I'll pick up after the demo setup.
Maya (People Ops): Great, thx everyone. Ping me in DMs if you run into badge issues. :thumbsup:
